scope: Candidate 1.2.0 supports processing-instruction targets in item-type aliases and supported structural sequence types. NCName and quoted-string targets retain case, normalize surrounding whitespace and are never expanded as type QNames. The parser validates targeted sequence-type syntax using a shared target reader; runtime matching compares the actual PI target. Malformed targets raise XPST0003 and quoted targets outside the NCName lexical space raise XPTY0004. Twelve new regressions verify identity, target/case mismatch, nesting, optional occurrences and static diagnostics. Partial wildcards, schema-annotated node tests, fn/named-parameter function grammar and package exposure remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Public version stays 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
